_comment: Guided tour for the ebFRET window. The window is drawn by emtk, so every target is a TourAnchor (gui/tool.py) kept over the real control and emitting clicked when it is used. Steps point and wait; they never press anything for the user. Read by chisurf.gui.widgets.tools.guided_tour.

steps.title: What this window does
steps.text:
ebFRET learns the states of a set of smFRET time series — how many there are, their FRET levels, their noise and their dwell times — with a hidden Markov model whose prior is shared by every trace and learned from all of them.

This walk-through loads a simulated dataset whose answer is known (four states at E = 0.10, 0.35, 0.55, 0.75) and runs one analysis. You press the buttons; the tour only points at them.

steps.title: Load data you can check
steps.text: Load demo simulates 40 donor/acceptor traces of a four-state molecule and loads them exactly as File → Load would load a raw .dat.

steps.title: One series at a time
steps.text: The top plot is the signal <tt>E = acceptor / (donor + acceptor)</tt>, the bottom one donor (green) and acceptor (red). After the analysis the most likely state path is drawn over both.

steps.title: Browse the series
steps.text: Select Series picks which series is shown. The edit box beside the slider takes a number.

await.hint: Drag the slider to another series.

steps.title: Crop and exclude
steps.text: Crop sets the frames of this series that enter the analysis; Exclude leaves it out. For a whole dataset, Analysis → Remove Photo-bleaching and Clip Outliers do this automatically — they are non-destructive and can be run again.

steps.title: The priors
steps.text: The Ensemble plots show, per state, the distribution of centers, noise and dwell times. Dashed is the prior: loading guessed one from the data. Analysis → Set Priors sets it by hand.

steps.title: How many states to try
steps.text: States → Min, Max is the range of state numbers analysed. The demo has four; set Max to 5 so the run finishes quickly and still tests one state too many. Type it and press Enter.

steps.title: Restarts and precision
steps.text: Restarts re-initialises each series' fit per iteration (0: continue; 1: plus an uninformative start; more: random starts). Precision is the convergence threshold — 1e-3 to explore, 1e-6 for results you publish.

steps.title: Run
steps.text: Run analyses every number of states from Min to Max (All) on the backend. The window keeps drawing and follows the series and state count being fitted; Stop ends it.

await.hint: Press Run. Each state count takes a while; you can go on meanwhile.

steps.title: Compare the models
steps.text: Select States shows the result for each number of states. The solid curves are the average posterior: with four states the centers settle on the simulated levels, with five one state stays nearly empty.

await.hint: Move Select States to another number of states.

steps.title: Keep the result
steps.text: File → Save writes the whole session as a .mat ebFRET reads; File → Export writes the analysis summary (with the lower bound that decides the number of states), the traces with their Viterbi paths, or an SMD.
